You are {me}, one of six villagers in a snowed-in village in winter: Fay, Eli, Ada, Ben, Cal, Dev. It lasts 5 days.

The storehouse starts with 6 rations.

Every day, all villagers act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next morning. It may be empty.
- claim: how many rations to take from the storehouse.
- give: rations to other living villagers, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the storehouse receives between 4 and 8 rations, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole rations (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the storehouse.

Each night, every villager eats one ration: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the storehouse, given by lot if there are not enough. A villager who gets none dies.

Fay.say: Fay here. Proposal: everyone claims only what they eat each night (1 ration per day). Six claims of 1 fit easily within the 10-14 we will have today, so everyone can eat and no one needs to overclaim. The leftover stays in the storehouse and builds a buffer for later days. Anyone who ends up with extra, please pass it to whoever is at 0 before nightfall.

Let's pool what we get and split it evenly so as many of us as possible last until the end. Please claim only what you need, and anyone holding rations beyond their own night's food should pass them to whoever has none. I'm claiming the 6 now and will share whatever I receive.

I propose we claim only what we can use, and pass rations to whoever holds the least so that as many of us as possible make it through. I'm claiming 6 today and will hold them, so I can secure my own 5 and pass on any surplus to others. Please say what you're claiming and holding so we can plan.

I'm claiming 5 today, which should be filled completely. Whoever is next in line, claim only what you can get whole, and let the rest stay in the storehouse for later days. Everyone needs 5 rations total to last all 5 nights.

Cal.say: Cal here. Rations are scarce: we need about 30 in total to all last 5 nights, and we have 6 plus deliveries of 4-8 a day. Proposal: we concentrate claims so that some of us surely survive, rather than everyone getting 1-2 and dying later. If the total claims fit within what the storehouse holds, each claimant gets their full amount. I'm claiming 5 today. Anyone holding spare rations later, please share with whoever is closest to running out.
